title: ficus infectoria var. fraseri
intro: Ficus infectoria var. fraseri, commonly known as Indian rubber tree, is a plant species that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is valued for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which have been shown to promote wound healing and reduce inflammation. The health benefits of Ficus infectoria var. fraseri include its ability to aid in the management of diabetes, as well as its potential to reduce the risk of heart disease and certain types of cancer. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and have been studied for their potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
